comment: Dr. C is great; her class is pretty easy, it's like AP Physics at a high school level. Although her lectures can be quick, if you do the homework beforehand, they are easy to follow. She's very lovely and approachable.

She is clear at explaining concepts and is happy to reexplain something during lectures. Practice problems are provided before every quiz (and there are a lot of quizzes), and she does a lot of problems in class. Labs and homework are graded on completion, while there are a lot of quizzes, two tests, and a final. She is a very fast grader.

I loved her! I will say a lot of her lectures are just her doing problems on the board, and she tends to go really fast so you want to make sure you don't fall behind if you don't understand something. Also I think I missed five classes-- she's very understanding about absences.
Managable class, a lot of quizzes almost every week or every other. 2 exams + final. HW is completion based. Very understanding and kind and helps when you need it.

Teaches the class like an AP class. Not a very intense class, especially for physics. She's understanding and helpful. Won't eat up too much of your time. Practice material is available and grade rests on plenty of quizzes.

One of the best profs I've had! Take her for Phys131 if you can. She gives so much practice material and makes it easy to be prepared for quizzes/exams. Quizzes are every 2 weeks, but they are similar to practice and homework questions. She is very accessible when you need help and will explain everything to you. Also just very nice!!!

Shes a ver good teacher. Shes very understanding of missed classes and lets you make up any work. Her lectures are clear and understandable. Very helpful in labs. I never reached out outside of class. Probably one of the best teachers I've ever had.
